# Test fixtures

These fixtures model PAYBACK coupon markup and response structures. Coupon identifiers have been replaced with synthetic values, activation states are test scenarios, and referral examples use placeholders or a dummy UUID. They contain no account credentials, CSRF tokens from a live session, customer identifiers or personal account inventory.

Partner IDs, store names, logos and coupon text describe public merchant/coupon data. Tests mock account requests; running the suite does not activate real coupons or place orders.
